niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers clean, spacious interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clearly separated sections, and simplified layouts that reduce clutter. They like content grouped into scan-friendly blocks or lists, with generous padding and breathing room. They favor clear navigation context when appropriate, especially visible app bars or bottom navigation, and prefer focused screens without distracting extra elements like search bars or competing imagery. Visually, they tend to like softer, cleaner styling: rounded corners, subtle outlines, restrained accent usage, and lighter or brighter surfaces rather than heavy dark fills. They also respond well to clear focal visuals such as prominent imagery or icons, and to CTAs that stand out through contrast, size, or thoughtful placement rather than sheer bulk.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong hierarchy with clear titles, section separation, grouped content blocks, and obvious focal points rather than flat or weakly organized layouts.
Prefers generous spacing, roomy vertical rhythm, lighter visual weight, and airier layouts over dense, tightly packed arrangements.
Prefers simplified screens that remove unnecessary elements and keep attention on the main task or message rather than busy, competing UI components.
Prefers information broken into distinct sections, bullets, grouped cards, or vertical lists that are easy to scan rather than long paragraphs or fragmented structures.
Prefers visible navigation structure such as top app bars, back/overflow controls, or persistent bottom navigation to provide context and orientation.
Prefers cleaner controls with subtle outlines, mixed button emphasis, rounded corners, and cohesive iconography rather than heavy filled elements or inconsistent control styles.

Prefers cohesive accent palettes, restrained color emphasis, lighter or brighter surfaces, soft gradients or blur, and prominent clear imagery or icons instead of harsh, heavy, or visually noisy treatments.
